description: Semantic search over your media-reference library AND shared curated moodboards — describe the look you want ('warm golden diner', 'neon night street') and get candidate images/clips with preview urls to show the user. Pass 'pack' to search inside one moodboard picked from list_reference_packs. With your lp_ key on this request your own uploaded refs are included; without it only the curated packs are searched. This tool never attaches: discuss candidates with the user, then pin chosen ids via referenceIds on generate_image.

pack.description: Scope search to one moodboard slug from list_reference_packs (e.g. 'neon-night')

query.description: Describe the look/mood/style — matched semantically against reference media

name: search_references
title: Search media references
